{{Quote|Droid pilots are no match for the real thing.|Bravo Twelve in reference to droid starfighters|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] had the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Bravo Twelve''' in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. He flew in [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During the invasion he was at a [[Naboo Resistance]] [[Naboo Resistance base|base]] and [[Mission in the Naboo canyon|helped defend]] the base from the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. He then [[Raid on the Solleu River|flew in a raid]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] to rescue [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]]. Bravo Twelve also participated in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final battle of the invasion]] and destroyed several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Bravo Twelve on your wing.|Bravo Twelve to Rhys Dallows during the raid on the Solleu River|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
The individual with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Bravo Twelve was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]' [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SW:SF" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Star Wars: Starfighter'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> He was at a [[Naboo Resistance base|resistance base]] in the [[Naboo training canyon]] when fellow Bravo Flight pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] [[Mission in the Naboo canyon|agreed to transport]] [[Skirmish over Naboo|captured]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] munitions to the resistance base. Bravo Twelve was supposed to escort him to the base, but when Dallows arrived, the escorts were not there. Dallows then led [[Reti]] into the canyon, where they found Bravo Twelve and [[Unidentified N-1 starfighter pilot|Bravo]] [[Bravo Eight|Eight]] in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] with [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab starfighters]], where Bravo Twelve boasted of the superiority of living pilots. Dallows destroyed the [[AMT]]s while the escorts finished off the Scarabs. Together, they continued down the canyon to the base and to the base, which was under attack from a large force of [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]].<ref name="SW:SF" />

Soon after, the three [[Naboo Resistance]] pilots [[Raid on the Solleu River|conducted a raid]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] to free [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] from the Trade Federation. Bravo Twelve engaged the Federation forces while the Rescue boats proceeded to the rendezvous point with the Naboo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="SW:SF" />

Bravo Twelve also participated in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final battle of the invasion]]. He attacked [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] while fellow Bravo pilot [[Rhys Dallows]] destroyed the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship's]] Receiver Stations. When the Stations were destroyed, he engaged a [[Unidentified mercenary leader|mercenary]] until the mercenary and Dallows became trapped inside the ship. The Droid Control Ship managed to reroute the signals, and Bravo Twelve continued the attack against the fighters.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Rob Paulsen]] provided the voice of Bravo Twelve in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. Bravo Twelve was also mentioned in [[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|the game's strategy guide]].
